text:
Maria (she/her): Quick idea — 5‑min plank relay at 12:20 on the rooftop? super quick, team format so you can tag someone when you're done. also lunchtime poll: bagel vs salad vs leftovers — vote with emoji :)
Devon: In for the plank relay. Low‑impact option please (back is grumpy today). :thumbsup:
Ryan: Can we start at 12:25 instead? wrapping a call. Bagel for lunch (classic). :bagel:
Samira: Love it. I’ll captain Team Green. I vote salad :green_salad: and I can do the mobility cooldown after.
FitBot: Heads up: scheduled plank relay reminder created. Suggested format:\n```\n- 4 teams of 3 (or fewer if people drop)\n- Each person: 45s plank, 15s tag/rest (knees ok)\n- 2 rounds total (~5m)\n- Mobility cooldown 3m: cat/cow, child's pose, hip flexor stretch\n```\nUse `/timer 00:45` for each hold.
Devon: Thanks FitBot — forearm plank and knees allowed for me. Will tag @Ryan when I'm done.
Maria (she/her): OK shifting to 12:25 to match Ryan. rooftop meet by the little planter. I'll bring a small bluetooth speaker and a timer. :speaker:
Ryan: Perfect. If I’m late hop without me. Also if salad wins I'm bringing extra dressing options. :salad:
Samira: Poll time — react to this thread with your lunch pick: :bagel: bagel, :green_salad: salad, :plate_with_cutlery: leftovers
Devon: Reacted with :green_salad: (and preemptive high five to whoever holds the longest)
Maria (she/her): Reacted :plate_with_cutlery: — leftovers champion.
Ryan: Reacted :bagel: — bagel crew. :raised_hands:
FitBot: Current quick tally (automated): bagel 1, salad 2, leftovers 1. Poll closes at 12:10.
Samira: Also bringing a spare yoga mat in case someone wants knees-down support.
Maria (she/her): Sweet. See you all at 12:25. Winner gets first pick of the office snacks. :trophy:
Devon: Bringing electrolytes. See you! :muscle:
Ryan: On my way after the call. If anyone's running late ping here and we'll wait max 3 mins.
Maria (she/her): Last call — anyone else joining? (cc @people-ops for the team wellness kudos)
